# AddAudioEffect <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
AddAudioEffect:Int32 bus:Int32, type:Int32, position:Int32=-1
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bus` | In | Int32 | required | A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus), or `0` for the master bus. Anything else is a runtime error. |
| `type` | In | Int32 | required | `BB_EFFECT_LOWPASS` to `BB_EFFECT_LOFI` (1 to 12) from the shipped include file audio.bb. `0`, which a `BB_` name is when audio.bb is not included, is a runtime error, and so is any other number. |
| `position` | In | Int32 | `-1` | Where in the chain it goes: `-1` (the default) at the end, `0` before the first effect, `1` before the second, and so on. A position past the end puts it at the end. Below -1 is a runtime error. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Adds an effect to the chain of a bus: a filter, EQ, echo, reverb, compressor, limiter, distortion or lo-fi. The effect works on everything that plays on the bus and on the buses that feed it, and keeps ringing after their sounds stop. See [Audio effects](Audio-Effects). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Differences

* The effects of a bus run in the order of the chain, then the volume of the bus is put on, and the result goes to the bus it feeds. A new effect starts with the defaults of its type.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Include "<audio.bb>"
world = CreateAudioBus()
muffle = AddAudioEffect(world, BB_EFFECT_LOWPASS)
AudioEffectParam muffle, BB_EFFECTPARAM_FREQUENCY, 800
```
@return The effect, for [AudioEffectParam](AudioEffectParam), [AudioEffectBypass](AudioEffectBypass) and [FreeAudioEffect](FreeAudioEffect). Effect handles are never the handle of a bus.
